statement: A graph \(G\) has \(n+k\) vertices. Let \(A\) be a subset of \(n\) vertices and \(B\) a subset of the other \(k\) vertices. Each vertex of \(A\) is joined to at least \(k-p\) vertices of \(B\). Prove that if \(np < k\) then there is a vertex in \(B\) joined to all vertices of \(A\).
Find all real \(x\) with \(0 < x < \pi\) such that \(\dfrac{8}{3\sin x - \sin 3x} + 3\sin^2 x \leq 5\).

Consider points \((x_1,y_1)\) with \(x_1>0, y_1>0\); \((x_2,y_2)\) with \(x_2<0, y_2>0\); \((x_3,y_3)\) with \(x_3<0, y_3<0\); \((x_4,y_4)\) with \(x_4>0, y_4<0\). Suppose \((x_i-a)^2+(y_i-b)^2 \leq c^2\) for each \(i=1,\ldots,4\). Prove that \(a^2+b^2 < c^2\). Restate as a geometric result.

Two circles with centers \(O, O'\) and radii \(R, R'\) meet at two points. A variable line \(L\) meets the circles at \(A, C, B, D\) in that order with \(\dfrac{AC}{AD} = \dfrac{CB}{BD}\). The feet of the perpendiculars from \(O, O'\) to \(L\) are \(H, H'\). Find the loci of \(H\) and \(H'\). If \(OO'^2 < R^2+R'^2\), find a point \(P\) on \(L\) minimizing \(PO+PO'\) and show this minimum is independent of \(L\).
